comparison.objective: Reset tongue-and-groove pliers from the first to the fifth groove.
comparison.physical_skill: Open the handles past a release angle, slide the joint, then close and lock it.
comparison.success_condition: Pliers lie flat, released and stable, locked in groove five under a push test.
comparison.reason: Tests reconfiguration of an articulated hand tool, without a second striking tool, fracture, or fragment recovery.
